items.title: Enforcing zero-trust dependency policies in AWS CodeBuild with JFrog Curation
items.summary: Integrate JFrog Curation into an AWS CodeBuild pipeline to block vulnerable and malicious open source packages at download time. A package that violates policy returns an HTTP 403 (Access Denied) error that fails the build, so a risky dependency never becomes a container image or reaches Amazon ECR.
items.creator: Arik Yakir
